Primary Text: The vehicle owner shall be able to securely pair their smartphone with the electric two-wheeler to enable digital key functionality.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show successful pairing process.

Primary Text: The E-Key 2W system shall support the secure provisioning of a digital key from the mobile application to the vehicle-side controller via the cloud lifecycle service.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify end-to-end key provisioning flow.

Primary Text: The digital key enrollment process shall complete within 15 seconds under nominal network conditions.
Verification Criteria: Test: Measure end-to-end enrollment time over 20 runs.

Primary Text: The Base mobile app shall discover an eligible vehicle via standard BLE and initiate enrollment.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify BLE discovery and enrollment initiation.

Primary Text: The Premium mobile app shall require on-device biometric authentication before initiating enrollment.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify biometric prompt blocks enrollment if failed.

Primary Text: The Fleet cloud service shall support bulk CSV upload for provisioning up to 10,000 keys simultaneously.
Verification Criteria: Test: Upload 10k CSV and verify provisioning success rate.

Primary Text: The system shall require authenticated owner identity before provisioning a digital key.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify unauthenticated user cannot provision key.

Primary Text: The rider shall experience seamless, hands-free unlocking and locking of the vehicle based on their physical proximity.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show vehicle unlocking as phone approaches.

Primary Text: The system shall automatically unlock or lock the vehicle when an authorized smartphone enters or leaves the defined proximity zone.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify proximity-based unlock and lock actions.

Primary Text: The Base variant end-to-end unlock decision shall complete within 1.5 seconds under nominal conditions.
Verification Criteria: Test: Measure BLE unlock latency over 50 runs.

Primary Text: The Premium variant UWB secure ranging handshake shall complete within 800ms.
Verification Criteria: Test: Measure UWB handshake latency over 50 runs.

Primary Text: The Base vehicle controller shall unlock using standard BLE RSSI thresholds (-65 dBm).
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify BLE RSSI triggers unlock.

Primary Text: The Premium vehicle controller shall unlock using UWB precise ranging to prevent relay attacks.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify UWB triggers unlock and rejects relay attacks.

Primary Text: The Fleet vehicle controller shall accept remote unlock commands from the Fleet Dispatcher API.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify Fleet API remote unlock command actuates mechanism.

Primary Text: The vehicle controller shall immediately reject unlock requests from an unrecognized digital key identifier.
Verification Criteria: Test: Unknown phone attempts to unlock; verify rejection.

Primary Text: The system shall ensure that only authorized riders with valid permissions can start and ride the vehicle.
Verification Criteria: Analysis: Review security architecture.

Primary Text: The system shall permit ride authorization only when the presented digital key is cryptographically valid, active, and not revoked.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify valid key permits ride, revoked key is rejected.

Primary Text: The vehicle ignition enable signal shall be triggered within 500ms of the mobile app sending the 'Ready to Ride' command.
Verification Criteria: Test: Measure time between app command and ignition relay.

Primary Text: The mobile application shall provide a clear UI indicator showing whether ride authorization is currently active.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify rider can view active ride authorization status.

Primary Text: The vehicle controller shall execute a cryptographic challenge-response handshake before enabling ignition.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify ignition is disabled if crypto handshake fails.

Primary Text: The vehicle owner shall be able to share constrained, temporary digital key access with other riders securely.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show owner creating a shared key.

Primary Text: The cloud key lifecycle service shall allow an owner to generate and distribute a shared digital key with configurable constraints.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify shared key expires and respects permissions.

Primary Text: The Base cloud service shall enforce time-based expiry constraints on shared keys.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify shared key expires at configured time.

Primary Text: The Premium cloud service shall enforce geofencing constraints on shared keys.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify shared key fails if used outside defined geo-zone.

Primary Text: The mobile application shall display a list of all currently active shared keys and their constraints.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify owner sees active shared keys list.

Primary Text: The vehicle owner shall have the ability to instantly revoke digital key access in case of loss or theft.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show owner revoking a key.

Primary Text: The system shall support immediate revocation of a shared digital key, propagating status to vehicle and mobile.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify owner can revoke and measure propagation time.

Primary Text: A revocation command received by the vehicle online shall become effective within 10 seconds.
Verification Criteria: Test: Measure online revocation propagation time.

Primary Text: The Fleet cloud service shall support bulk API revocation for up to 1,000 keys simultaneously.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify bulk API revokes 1k keys within 30s.

Primary Text: The system shall allow owners to customize rider access based on specific time windows or usage restrictions.
Verification Criteria: Analysis: Review UI/UX and permission schemas.

Primary Text: The system shall support the configuration and enforcement of rider profiles, including time-window access.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify rider access is denied outside time window.

Primary Text: The Premium mobile app shall allow the owner to restrict a specific rider's access to a configured time window.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify owner can set and save time window.

Primary Text: The Fleet Dashboard shall allow admins to assign shift-based profiles to riders.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify rider can only unlock during assigned shift.

Primary Text: The system shall provide a secure, temporary access mode for valet or service personnel.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show creation and usage of a temporary service key.

Primary Text: The system shall allow the generation of a temporary service key with predefined, limited permissions.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify temporary service key works only with restricted permissions.

Primary Text: The Base vehicle controller shall limit max speed to 20km/h when a service key is active.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify speed is limited under valet mode.

Primary Text: The Premium vehicle controller shall disable trunk release and limit speed when a service key is active.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify trunk disabled and speed limited.

Primary Text: The system shall maintain a secure, auditable log of all security-relevant events.
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Review security event log schema.

Primary Text: The system shall record all failed authorization attempts and expose them only to authorized users.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify failed attempts create event and unauthorized users cannot read.

Primary Text: The Base variant shall retain security logs for a minimum of 1 year.
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Verify cloud DB retention policy.

Primary Text: The Premium variant shall retain high-fidelity telemetry and security logs for 5 years immutably.
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Verify Data Lake retention and WORM policy.

Primary Text: The Fleet variant shall stream security events to external SIEM systems via Webhook.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify SIEM receives formatted security events.

Primary Text: The user shall be able to remotely check the basic status of the vehicle.
Verification Criteria: Demonstration: Show app displaying accurate status.

Primary Text: The system shall periodically synchronize and display the vehicle's latest known connection status and battery.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify app shows latest lock state and battery.

Primary Text: The Base app shall display lock state via standard REST polling every 60s.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify app UI reflects lock state.

Primary Text: The Premium app shall receive real-time lock state updates via WebSockets.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify app updates instantly on lock change.

Primary Text: The Fleet Dashboard shall display real-time telemetry for 10k vehicles via WebSockets.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify dashboard updates 10k pins within 5s.

Primary Text: The vehicle shall remain operable for a limited period if cloud connectivity is temporarily lost.
Verification Criteria: Analysis: Review offline grace period risk assessment.

Primary Text: The system shall support a limited offline grace period, allowing ride authorization without real-time cloud validation.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify vehicle permits offline grace and rejects after expiry.

Primary Text: The maximum allowable offline grace period shall be 72 hours.
Verification Criteria: Test: Simulate 73 hours offline; verify vehicle rejects ride.

Primary Text: The offline grace mode shall strictly terminate when its configured validity window expires.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify expired offline grace is rejected.

Primary Text: The platform shall enforce TLS 1.3 encryption for all data in transit.
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Review network captures for TLS 1.3.

Primary Text: The platform shall enforce AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data at rest in databases and object storage.
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Verify database and S3/GCS bucket encryption settings.

Primary Text: The platform shall manage all API keys, database credentials, and cryptographic seeds via a centralized secrets manager.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify no hardcoded secrets exist in source code or environment variables.

Primary Text: The platform shall undergo automated container vulnerability scanning in the CI/CD pipeline before deployment.
Verification Criteria: Test: Introduce a CVE into a Dockerfile; verify pipeline blocks deployment.

Primary Text: The Global variant shall enforce data residency (EU in Frankfurt, US in Oregon).
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Verify cloud DB region routing.

Primary Text: The Global variant shall comply with CCPA by providing an 'Opt-Out of Sale of Personal Information' mechanism.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify user can toggle opt-out and data sharing ceases.

Primary Text: The system shall provide a 'Right to be Forgotten' API endpoint that permanently deletes all user PII within 30 days.
Verification Criteria: Test: Call deletion API; verify DB records are purged.

Primary Text: The mobile app shall implement a granular consent management UI for data collection (analytics, location, push notifications).
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify app respects user consent toggles in real-time.

Primary Text: The system shall provide a 'Data Portability' API endpoint allowing users to export all their data in a machine-readable JSON format.
Verification Criteria: Test: Call export API; verify JSON contains all user PII and activity logs.

Primary Text: The API Gateway shall enforce rate limiting of 100 requests/minute per user to prevent abuse and DDoS.
Verification Criteria: Test: Send 101 requests in 60s; verify 429 Too Many Requests response.

Primary Text: The platform shall utilize read replicas for the primary database to offload read-heavy telemetry queries.
Verification Criteria: Analysis: Review database architecture diagram for read replica configuration.

Primary Text: The platform shall serve all static mobile app assets (images, binaries) via a global Content Delivery Network (CDN).
Verification Criteria: Test: Request asset from US and EU; verify response from nearest edge location.

Primary Text: Core platform services (Auth, Key Lifecycle) shall be deployed across multiple Availability Zones (Multi-AZ).
Verification Criteria: Inspection: Review cloud infrastructure deployment topology.

Primary Text: The platform shall perform automated daily backups of all databases with a Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) window of 35 days.
Verification Criteria: Test: Simulate data corruption; restore database to 1 hour prior.

Primary Text: The platform shall implement graceful degradation; if the Cloud Key Service is unreachable, the Mobile App shall cache the last known state and queue actions.
Verification Criteria: Test: Block cloud access; verify app queues actions and syncs when restored.

Primary Text: The platform shall aggregate all application, security, and access logs into a centralized logging service.
Verification Criteria: Test: Generate log in microservice A; verify it appears in centralized dashboard.

Primary Text: The platform shall trigger automated alerts (PagerDuty/Slack) when API error rates exceed 1% over a 5-minute window.
Verification Criteria: Test: Inject 500 errors; verify alert is triggered within 5 minutes.

Primary Text: The platform shall implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) to track request flows across Mobile, API Gateway, and Microservices.
Verification Criteria: Test: Generate request; verify trace ID is present in all downstream service logs.

Primary Text: The platform shall implement automated data lifecycle policies, moving telemetry older than 90 days to cold storage.
Verification Criteria: Test: Insert record with timestamp > 90 days; verify it moves to cold storage.

Primary Text: The Global variant shall handle all time-based operations (rider profiles, logs) in UTC and convert to local timezone at the presentation layer.
Verification Criteria: Test: Create time-window in Tokyo; verify it displays correctly in New York.

Primary Text: The platform shall enforce ISO 8601 standards for all date and time data exchanged via APIs.
Verification Criteria: Test: Verify all API JSON responses use 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ' format.

Primary Text: The mobile app shall support dynamic localization for 15 languages based on device OS settings.
Verification Criteria: Test: Change device language to Japanese; verify app UI updates.

Primary Text: The mobile application and web dashboards shall comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
Verification Criteria: Test: Run automated accessibility scanner (e.g., axe-core); verify zero critical violations.
